backdrop.bias: soft: holding $81K after the Oct 22 drop; ETF flows flipped to outflows
backdrop.commentary: Morning (6:25 AM CT, Oct 23): BTC ~$81.56K (-0.4% 24h; 24h $80.99K-$81.93K) is steadying after Thursday's slide (Oct 22 low $80.82K, Investing.com BRTI); CoinDesk has it back near $81.7K with altcoins rebounding a little faster and traders looking to the Fed's Oct 27-28 meeting. Flows turned: US spot BTC ETFs lost a net $635.6M on Oct 22, the largest daily outflow since Jun 25 (week to date still +$439.1M); ETH funds lost $110.6M (Farside via CryptoWatchDesk). Macro is still the driver: US futures are mixed after the AI-led tech selloff, Brent is near $114 and WTI above $100 (AP, Yahoo Finance). Signals: 1h Neutral, 4h Sell under the 4h EMAs (~$82.1K-82.3K), 1d Neutral (under the EMA20 ~$82.45K, above the EMA50 ~$80.8K). Fear & Greed 48 (neutral), OKX funding ~0.01%. Yen: USD/JPY ~156.9 (Yahoo; day range 156.07-157.16), down from 158.5 on Oct 20, about a 1% yen gain in three sessions; that is firm but not a disorderly carry unwind, and 155 hasn't broken. Japan's September core CPI was 2.1% (in line) and core-core 2.4% (above the 2.3% forecast), which firms a December BOJ hike while next week's Oct 29-30 meeting is expected to hold at 1.25% (Nikkei Asia/Reuters, FXStreet). The Nikkei is ~62,700 after a 1,713-point drop on Oct 22 (OANDA). A fast move toward 155 or a hawkish BOJ surprise is the risk to watch, so leverage stays low. Policy: the CLARITY market-structure bill is still stalled, with the SEC and CFTC moving on rules under existing authority (CFTC comments due Dec 14; The Block, Baker Botts). In Asia, HSBC's licensed HKD stablecoin RedCoin went live on PayMe for 3.3M users (CoinDesk), a steady adoption signal rather than a price driver. The T009 swing long still waits at $79.9K-80.4K; a 4h close under $79.5K before it fills would cancel the idea.

ripple.bias: bearish daily trend: between the 1.30 floor and the 1.36-1.39 EMA cluster
ripple.commentary: Morning (6:25 AM CT, Oct 23): XRP ~$1.32 (-0.9% 24h; 24h $1.30-$1.33) held the $1.30 floor overnight (24h low $1.30) and is drifting with BTC. Structure: the 20-, 50- and 200-day EMAs are stacked overhead at ~$1.361 / $1.370 / $1.374, just under the Oct 21-22 high (~$1.389); below, the Oct lows are $1.26-1.28 (30-day low ~$1.259). Signals: 1d Strong Sell (price < EMA20 < EMA50, below EMA200), 4h Sell under the 4h EMAs (~$1.325-1.331), 1h Neutral (RSI ~44). New: T011, a medium-conviction 3x swing short that only fills on a relief rally into $1.355-1.37 (the daily EMA cluster), stop $1.392 above the Oct 21-22 high, targets $1.30 / $1.265. No chase from here: a short at $1.32 has only ~1.5% to the floor. News is constructive but slow-moving: Arf (~$10B annual settlement volume) is bringing RLUSD settlement financing for licensed payment firms to XRPL, though no committed XRPL volume was disclosed (crypto.news); CryptEscrow announced a real-estate settlement partnership with Ripple (GlobeNewswire); US spot XRP ETFs took in a small $3.55M on Oct 22 (SoSoValue via Odaily). The XRPL fixCleanup amendment activates Nov 4. A daily close above $1.39 would void the bearish read; a daily close under $1.30 opens $1.26-1.28.

stellar.bias: bearish: daily downtrend, basing just above the 0.172 30-day low
stellar.commentary: Morning (6:25 AM CT, Oct 23): XLM ~$0.1761 (-1.0% 24h; 24h $0.1747-$0.1787) is holding the bottom of its base after Thursday's drop (24h low $0.1747), with the 30-day low ($0.1720) about 2% below. Signals: 1d Strong Sell under the daily EMAs (~$0.188-0.192), 4h Sell under the 4h EMAs (~$0.179-0.181), 1h Neutral (RSI ~40). The pending T003 short (zone $0.1895-0.1915) never got its rally and expires unfilled at noon CT today; it can't be re-entered for its levels (price is already past T1). No new setup: a short this close to the 30-day low has little room, and a long needs the base to hold and a reclaim of ~$0.1807 first. Dated events: Meridian (Oct 28-29), the Bell / Protocol 30 testnet vote Nov 3 and the mainnet validator vote Nov 23, 17:00 UTC (ad-hoc-news citing CryptoTicker).

xdce-crowd-sale.bias: constructive: back above the 0.034 shelf; ceiling 0.0355-0.0360
